name: Speech bubble
what: A speech bubble pops out of its tail and pulses (a dip and a colour flip every 24 frames), or a round pill with an emoji that waves - a message, a reaction, a callout next to someone talking.

learned_from.what: a black bubble popping from its tail and pulsing
a pill with an emoji waving

motion: pops from the tail: 0 -> 1.12 in 7 f, settle back.out 10 f; a pulse every 24 f (a 4 f dip + the colour flips); the emoji waves 5 x 5 f
